label: Hirschmann RS30 OpenRail 16-port + 2x 1G SFP
description: Hirschmann RS30 compact OpenRail managed DIN-rail switch: 16x 100M RJ45 plus 2x 1G SFP uplink cages (18 ports in total). Both gigabit uplinks are SFP slots, so this variant has no copper uplink at all.
notes: Family facts from the vendor installation manual (https://www.doc.hirschmann.com/pdf/IG_RS20_RS30_RS40_Managed_08_0325_en_2025-03-27.pdf): an RS30 has two gigabit uplink ports ('Ports 1 and 2, 1000 Mbit/s, media selectable, SFP, RJ45') beside 8, 16 or 24 10/100 Mbit/s TP RJ45 ports. The V.24 management connection is an RJ11 socket and the separate USB port is only for the ACA21-USB auto-configuration adapter, so neither is a data port. Power 12/24/48 V DC (9.6-60 V) or 24 V AC (18-30 V) on a redundant 6-pin terminal block. Temperature class letter in the code: S = standard 0 to +60 C, T and E = extended -40 to +70 C. Software variant letter: E = Layer 2 Enhanced, P = Professional. Layer 2 only: Belden lists switching, redundancy and management, never routing, so these specs carry no l3-forward. Belden's product sheet for this exact order code (943 434-035) states '18 Ports in total, 2 Gigabit Ethernet ports; 1. uplink: Gigabit SFP-Slot; 2. uplink: Gigabit SFP-Slot; 16 x standard 10/100 BASE TX, RJ45'. O6 = SFP slot at 1000 Mbit/s, the cages taking the M-SFP-SX/LC and M-SFP-LX/LC modules Belden lists, so speedCaps is [1000] and not the FE/GE pair a combo position would carry. Sheet: https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/957/943434035.PDF
